newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 index closes down 4.6 pts at 595.1.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 index closes down 4.6 pts at 595.1.

text.p: 1500 GMT - Czech blue chip shares close lower on the Prague Stock Exchange on Monday, pulling the PX50 index down 4.6 points, or 0.77 percent, to 595.1.
*Overall, 266 issues rise, 235 fall and 117 hold steady.
*Total volume 1.62 million shares on turnover of 1.92 billion crowns.
